item: Order-dependent tests fixed at the cause in six test files
key_paths: tests/test_discovery_isolation.py; tests/test_errorlog_summary.py; tests/test_patterns_lens_gate.py; tests/test_pre_restore_snapshot_sweep.py; tests/test_search_instant.py; tests/test_storage_events.py
summary: A random-order run (pytest-randomly seed 1111, 4 workers, twice) failed 10 tests and erred 10. Six test files were the cause: a module reload that doubled the error-log handler, leftover pre-restore snapshots, the storage writer's failure count outliving reset_for_tests, an instant-search coverage test that assumed file order, a discovery fixture that wiped every source and on a foreign-key error kept the write lock (8 database-is-locked failures in 4 other files), and OO_DATA_DIR set without restore (country form read as alpha2). Test-only fixes, each red first; the same seed is then green.
